rules.statement: A party invoking the provisions of section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance to defeat the ownership of an adverse claimant to immovable property must establish a starting point for their acquisition of prescriptive rights, which must be undisturbed, uninterrupted, adverse to or independent of that of the former possessor and must have lasted for at least ten years.
rules.supporting_quote: According to section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance such a possession must be undisturbed, uninterrupted, adverse to or independent of that of the former possessor and should have lasted for at least ten years before he could transform such possession into prescriptive title.
